allow: Bash(sqlcmd -S "pc133\\sqlexpress" -E -d QuinielaDB -Q "SELECT 'Teams' AS [Table], COUNT\(*\) AS [Count] FROM Teams UNION ALL SELECT 'Matches', COUNT\(*\) FROM Matches WHERE Stage=0 UNION ALL SELECT 'Users', COUNT\(*\) FROM AspNetUsers UNION ALL SELECT 'AdminRole', COUNT\(*\) FROM AspNetRoles WHERE [Name]='Admin'")
Bash(sqlcmd -S "pc133\\sqlexpress" -E -d QuinielaDB -Q "SELECT GroupCode, Name, FlagCode FROM Teams ORDER BY GroupCode, Name")
Bash(sqlcmd -S "pc133\\sqlexpress" -E -d QuinielaDB -Q "SELECT Name, LEN\(Name\) AS Len FROM Teams WHERE FlagCode IN \('mx','es','fr','gb-eng','kr'\) ORDER BY FlagCode")
Bash(sqlcmd -S "pc133\\sqlexpress" -d QuinielaDB -E -Q "SELECT Stage, COUNT\(*\) AS Cnt FROM Matches GROUP BY Stage ORDER BY Stage")

Bash(sqlcmd -S "pc133\\sqlexpress" -d QuinielaDB -E -Q "SELECT m.BracketOrder, m.KickoffUtc, m.Venue, h.Name AS Home, a.Name AS Away FROM Matches m JOIN Teams h ON m.HomeTeamId=h.Id JOIN Teams a ON m.AwayTeamId=a.Id WHERE m.Stage=1 ORDER BY m.BracketOrder")

Bash(sqlcmd -S "pc133\\sqlexpress" -d QuinielaDB -E -Q "SELECT m.Stage, m.BracketOrder, m.KickoffUtc, h.ShortCode AS Home, a.ShortCode AS Away, m.HomeSlotLabel, m.AwaySlotLabel FROM Matches m LEFT JOIN Teams h ON m.HomeTeamId=h.Id LEFT JOIN Teams a ON m.AwayTeamId=a.Id WHERE m.Stage IN \(2,3,4,5,6\) ORDER BY m.Stage, m.BracketOrder")

PowerShell(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5299 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { Get-Process -Id $_ -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id, ProcessName, Path, StartTime })

PowerShell(sqlcmd -S 'pc133\\sqlexpress' -d QuinielaDB -E -Q "SELECT TOP 5 m.Stage, m.Status, p.Points, p.PtsResult, p.PtsInstance FROM Predictions p JOIN Matches m ON m.Id = p.MatchId WHERE m.Status = 1 ORDER BY m.Id" -C)
